about.heading: About me
about.p1: I'm a personal trainer and group fitness instructor. My experience as a mother led me to specialize in Hypopressive Gymnastics and postpartum training techniques. Now I help other mothers recover their figure and feel their best.
about.p2: With unstoppable energy, my methodology is highly personalized. I work with young people looking to improve their physique and health, as well as older adults who want to gain quality of life and stay active and healthy.
about.p3: I made a bold career change from customer service in Barcelona to the fitness world. I've trained across multiple sports disciplines and continue to learn and grow to perform at my best every day.
about.imgAlt: Tania working out at the gym
about.summaryP1: With over 10 years of experience in personal training and group classes, I help you reach your goals with customized plans tailored to your body and lifestyle.
